published.source: forever-sim's paladin re-search on the October 30 hotfix trees, 2026-11-01 (wowsimcli on this request, 20,000 iterations, seed 1, 180 ± 20 s); the DPS report data isn't regenerated yet

summary: Ret Shock (deep Holy) with Exorcism, for an Undead or Demon boss. When mana runs short, it casts Light's Vigil only above 60% mana.
advantage: Exorcism and Holy Wrath only work on Undead and Demons. This build adds Exorcism to the Holy Shock rotation.
advantageShort: Exorcism only hits Undead and Demons. This build adds it to the Holy Shock rotation.
rotation: The spell power on-use trinket at the pull, then held for the execute phase when that loses no use; Goblin Sapper Charge on cooldown
Consecration on cooldown at any mana
Seal of Righteousness whenever it's down
Hammer of Wrath under 20% boss health, before Holy Strike
Exorcism on cooldown (only against Undead and Demons)
consumes: Elixir of Greater Firepower (Forever's Holy Power elixir)
caveats: Takes Pursuit of Justice 2 (movement speed), a must-have talent.
Light's Vigil heals only and Holy Power gives crit healing only since the October 30 hotfix.
Takes the Dragonfire Potion: +5.8 at 180s over the Major Mana Potion, 5.6 behind at 300s.

Two-Handed Weapon Specialization boosts the Holy seal and judgement damage and Holy Strike too, as measured in game before the October 30 hotfix. The hotfix tooltip says physical damage, but its damage effect is unchanged.
Unverified: Holy Strike's flat bonus is added before its weapon damage percent, as the client data says.
The top Holy Strike and Consecration ranks may be out of date (about 1.2% of DPS).

Seal of Righteousness adds 12% of spell power per hit with a two-hander, counted once, as its tooltip says (spell 70425). Counted twice, DPS would be 46-51 higher. At the proc spell's 0%, it would be 53-59 lower.
No filler explosive, because each 1s cast resets the swing.
notes: Request from mksettings with the same arguments as paladin__level_60_shock except talents and APL, then the target's mobType set to MobTypeUndead, as the class preset's encounter does. Undead since the 2026-10-27 race re-pick (the race sweep with each race's own rotation and gear, standards 29), was Human (follows its base build, paladin__level_60_shock). The raid's Sunder Armor ramps since 2026-10-31 (standard 32, mksettings -sunder ramp): a warrior tank stacks it from the pull and one DPS warrior casts it on its first GCD. Talents, rotation and its notes re-searched on 2026-11-01 for the launch realms' October 30 hotfix trees (1.60.1.70707+hf); the request is the earlier one with the new talentsString and rotation (tools/rotopt/paladin_presets.sh). The Dragonfire Potion in place of the Major Mana Potion (mksettings -spec ret_shock is the same as ret since then).
